Dhanraj G. Badhe

Senior Consultant, Payments Phone No. 7709418725, Email- dhanrajbande25@gmail.com

PROFSSIONAL SUMMARY

SAFe® Certified Product Owner/Product Manager. Currently working as a Senior Consultant in SWIFT Payments, Custody & Capital markets domain. Total 8+ years of experience in BA/PM - Banking domain, Change management, risk and operations. Solutions driven with assisting cross functional teams in development. Working towards attaining organizational goals and delivery of process innovations.

Having diversified experience working in multiple domains of custody (Trade & Custody, Cross border payments, Equity & Bonds, Query management, reconciliation functionalities, Knowledge of SWIFTs (ISO 20022, MTs). A competent professional with effective communication skills and keen to learn new things.

EXPERIENCE

Current role: Senior Consultant - DXC Luxoft Technology, August 2025 - Till date

Project - sBilling

This project involves streamlining of the Billing process for major custodian bank via standardization and rolling out a

global integration platform for all the branches. The system is expected to have automated integration with the data sources and interface the upstream systems. My role as a Business Analyst consists of the below:

Writing test cases, user stories and acceptance criteria. • Documenting the user manuals, system architecture, flow diagrams and sequence diagrams Creation of UAT test data and staging the data for various fees charged.

Performing testing in UAT environment. • Obtaining sign offs from operations users. • Working closely with development team to make sure requirements are well understood and propose solution and discuss Pros and cons with the stakeholders and product owners.

Previous role: Senior Consultant - Cognizant Technology Services, March 2024 - August 2025

Project – CSFS Payment automation:

The project focused on improving efficiency of manual payment process and integration of the systems involved

associated with the various use cases of Capital call payments for Private Equity & Private Asset fund. My role comprised of understanding and preparing of Business documents, payment flow, automation and implementation of new functionalities, evaluation of problem statements and solutions.

Responsibilities:

Preparation/enhancements of BRDs, FRDs. • Writing and understanding of use cases. • Collaborating with the stakeholders to understand and present As is & To be flow. • Obtaining sign off on the workflows, LRDs, draft and final version of the documents. • Mapping data. • Preparation of test data & test cases. • Perform testing on Dev and UAT environment, Conducting knowledge transfer sessions with dev and testing team.

Previous role: Business Analyst - Digital, Maveric Systems, October 2023 - March 2024

Provided domain trainings to the development team members. • Assisted in documentation for internal projects.

Previous role: Senior Business Analyst - Xoriant Solutions Pvt. Ltd., September 2022 - October 2023

Project – Custody taxation:

Responsibilities:

Engage with the clients to understand and gather their requirements on the application development from the broker dealers and investors perspective (U.S. region).

Change Management. • Participation in various scrum ceremonies with the product owner, scrum master and scrum team. • Preparation and enrichment of the use cases and demo presentations of the same. • Lead Backlog Grooming meeting and listing the vital requirements for the development team.

Specialist - State Street, July 2020 - September 2022

Project - ABO - MCH is a multi-feature application, where the Client service teams can input and track the trades status as

SWIFT instruction process. Additional approval step is required for Cash and Security transactions due to regulatory and business reasons. Project will benefit include replacing fax based manual instructions by SWIFT based STP leading to reduced operational risk and reduced processing time. MCH provides all the transaction details to the user. The user can find both the cash payment SWIFTs (MT202/MT103/MT210) & trade SWIFT proprietary message type called MT messages (MT-54x, MT-56x series).

Project - PBI Trades risk: Introduced and implemented the functionalities in order to mitigate the risk of Potential Buy-in trades loss for the clients. Detailed FRD was drafted and implemented to reduce the buy-in penalties risk for the APAC clients (China, Singapore, Malaysia).

Sub-project - Instruct Lite: Instruct Lite is an application where client directly releases MT-599 Swifts for any

amendments to the State Streets sub-custodians.

Worked with the development team in order to set-up an application where Client wishes to process the payments/fund injections via MT-599 (free format) instead of MT-202/MT-202 cov. The application works as viewer and checker for the MT-599(free format). Automation projects: Assisted onshore management in creating user stories for successful automation and implementation of CSM tool.

Responsibilities:

• Creation of FRD for Trade browsing, client facing team and Buy-in trades for Singapore & Malaysia markets. • Create Business/Functional user stories. • Review Product backlog with Product Owner and team. • Writing test cases & test plans. • Attend Daily Stand up, Sprint Review, Refinement & Retrospective meetings with Business & Technology. Escalate • Raise bugs and defect management.

Implemented/enhanced functionalities for Trade settlement and recon team via STP/MT-54x series.

any business or technology issues to senior management for timely solution.

• • Creating Wireframes and process flows.

JIRA Management.

Previous role: Analyst - BNY Mellon India, July 2017 - November 2019.

Project FiRRe: This billing project focused on standardization of the billing tool for the various services provided by BNY Mellon as a custodian. BNY Mellon charges various types of fees to its clients for the services provided. The user of the FiRRe application can view and set up various fees that are being charged by BNY Mellon to its clients. The billing cycles could be set up for each client as per Fee schedule/Custody agreements.

Tasks & Responsibilities:

Requirements Gathering. • Creation of process flows. • Drafting Change requests. • Real time Testing on tool. • Operational Readiness Obtaining sign offs from stakeholders. • Support after Implementation. • Maintenance of Project SharePoint and Confluence pages. • Daily, Weekly and Steer Co meeting reports and presentations.

Previous role: Auditor - PRGX India Pvt. Ltd., November 2015 - March 2017.

Worked on projects such as Pricing, Lump sum and point of sales. • Audited data and gathered inputs for the various reputed clients with a successful track record.

Technical Skills

MS-Office, Visio, SQL (basics), JIRA, Confluence, SQUASH.

Education

Completed Master of commerce in Banking and Finance from Symbiosis International University in year 2015. • Completed Bachelor of Commerce in Banking and Information Technology from Nagpur University in year 2013.

Achievements, Awards and Recognitions

Received Pinnacle award twice for introduction of new functionalities (State Street Bank).

Received WOW award thrice (BNY Mellon) for the automation.

Successful transition of projects to Poland team. • Led Symbiosis swimming team as a captain at university level competitions

Personal Details Nationality - Indian

Languages known - English, Hindi, Marathi

Declaration I hereby declare that all the information provided by me above is correct to the best of my knowledge
